mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1
SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.rating DESC, p.orders DESC
SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE p.region = #{region} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.rating DESC, p.orders DESC
SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{style}, p.styles) > 0 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.rating DESC, p.orders DESC
SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE p.price = #{price} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.orders DESC
SELECT p.* FROM photographer p WHERE p.certified = #{certified} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.rating DESC, p.orders DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photographer (user_id, name, avatar, certified, certified_time, orders, rating, price, region, styles, cover_image, bio, works, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{certified}, #{certifiedTime}, #{orders}, #{rating}, #{price}, #{region}, #{styles}, #{coverImage}, #{bio}, #{works}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE photographer SET orders = #{orders} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE photographer SET rating = #{rating} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE photographer SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
